suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as pulmonary disease complication. Require documented bronchiectasis and separately established bronchiectasis-associated pulmonary hypertension, preferably with appropriate hemodynamic evidence such as right-heart catheterization when clinically available, and evaluation sufficient to distinguish major alternative causes of pulmonary hypertension. PMID 38860405 supports the established bronchiectasis-associated PH phenotype and its prognostic hemodynamics; it should not be used to estimate PH incidence in unselected bronchiectasis or to infer PH from bronchiectasis severity alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-10 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. In adults with established bronchiectasis, polysomnography-confirmed obstructive sleep apnea is substantially more prevalent than in the general population; this supports screening and a population-level association only. Do not infer obstructive sleep apnea from bronchiectasis alone. Require a separate obstructive sleep apnea diagnosis. Preserve obesity, craniofacial or anatomic upper-airway factors, age, sex, medication exposure, other sleep-disordered-breathing causes, and conventional obstructive sleep apnea risk factors. Association evidence must not be presented as individual causation. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
